bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All three authored RUSD deployments are reviewed as independent issuer-native canonical issuance routes on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Tron. The verified RoyalDollar contracts expose local mint/burn and role controls but no bridge endpoint, lockbox, peer, message, validator, or cross-chain supply path; those issuer admins remain exclusively in Mint Authority. R-Bridge / RxBridge is an off-chain or hybrid settlement ecosystem, not an on-chain token bridge.
